rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining capped below the session VWAP ($12.56) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.54). Over the last five minutes, price has steadily climbed on expanding volume—culminating in an 82.4k share 1-minute candle closing at $12.63—and reclaimed both key resistance levels. With the structural resistance broken and momentum turning upward against the short, closing now avoids taking the full stop loss at $12.66 while respecting the strongly bearish broader market regime by not flipping long.
